scientific_gates.exceeds_five_points: lower 95% bound > +5 under both schemas with no sign flip: evidence that the effect EXCEEDS five points
scientific_gates.positive_effect: lower 95% bound > 0 under both schemas with no sign flip: evidence that the effect is POSITIVE; says nothing about its size
scientific_gates.reconciliation: the two gates answer different questions and have very different power. A true 5-point effect can never be shown to exceed 5 points (its lower bound sits below 5 by construction); a true 10-point effect needs several hundred groups for that gate. Around 200-350 groups the design is an EXPLORATORY POSITIVE-EFFECT SCREEN: it does NOT confirm a five-point effect unless the true effect is substantially larger (about 10 points or more)
